fields.label: Ingredient cost target
fields.question: Out of every KES 100 you sell, how much should ingredients cost at most?

fields.label: Ingredients + wages target
fields.question: Out of every KES 100 you sell, how much can ingredients plus wages cost at most?

fields.label: Lowest share you keep on a dish
fields.question: What is the lowest share of a dish's price you are willing to keep after its ingredients?

fields.label: Share you would like to keep on a dish
fields.question: What share of a dish's price would you like to keep after its ingredients?

fields.label: What counts as a popular dish
fields.question: How well must a dish sell, compared with your average dish, to count as popular?

fields.label: Missing stock we flag
fields.question: How much more stock than your recipes explain should we accept before flagging missing stock?

fields.label: Cash count difference we accept
fields.question: How far off can a cash count be, in shillings, before we ask you to check it?

fields.label: Cash count difference we accept (share of takings)
fields.question: We use the larger of the shilling amount and this share: what share of the shift's cash takings can a count be off by?

fields.label: Uber Eats commission
fields.question: What commission does Uber Eats take on each order?

fields.label: Glovo commission
fields.question: What commission does Glovo take on each order?

fields.label: Bolt Food commission
fields.question: What commission does Bolt Food take on each order?

fields.label: Offer size
fields.question: How big a discount are you willing to try on a dish that is selling slowly?

fields.label: Extra sales you expect from an offer
fields.question: How many extra plates do you expect to sell when you run an offer?

fields.label: Biggest price rise at once
fields.question: What is the biggest price rise you would make in one go?

fields.label: Price rounding step
fields.question: What step should suggested prices round up to, in shillings?

fields.label: How guests react to price changes
fields.question: How strongly do your guests react when a price changes?
fields.hint: -1.2 means guests react a lot; -0.4 means hardly at all.

fields.label: Wages target
fields.question: Out of every KES 100 you sell, how much should wages cost at most?

fields.label: Overtime starts after
fields.question: After how many hours in a day does overtime start?

fields.label: Urgent alerts per day
fields.question: How many urgent alerts are we allowed to send you in one day?

fields.label: Quiet hours start
fields.question: From what hour of the night should we stay quiet?

fields.label: Quiet hours end
fields.question: Until what hour of the morning should we stay quiet?

fields.label: Licence warning
fields.question: How many days before a licence expires should we warn you?

fields.label: Cost increase we flag
fields.question: How far above your usual should a cost be, before we tell you it is going up?
fields.hint: Your usual is what that cost averaged over the last three months.

fields.label: Cash you keep aside for bills
fields.question: How much cash do you keep aside for bills?
fields.hint: We count it when we check whether your sales will cover the bills that fall due.
